task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 162 to 162 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "linen" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "always" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

Dear team,

I wanted to provide a quick update on the project’s progress. We’ve made significant headway in finalizing the design specifications, and the initial prototype is looking remarkably good. The client expressed considerable satisfaction with the visual representation, particularly the color palette and the overall layout. We’re currently focusing on integrating the user interface elements and ensuring seamless functionality across different platforms. I’ve requested additional linen for the testing phase to accommodate the expanded scope. It's vital we maintain this momentum and diligently address any potential issues that might arise. Let’s continue to collaborate effectively to deliver a truly exceptional product, reflecting our shared dedication to quality.

Furthermore, I’d like to emphasize the importance of thorough testing and feedback incorporation. We should schedule a meeting next week to review the test results and refine the design further. I believe a structured approach will prevent future complications. Remember to document all changes and communicate them clearly. Let’s prioritize open communication and mutual support throughout this final stage. Let’s make sure everything is perfect, utilizing the finest linen available for our final product demonstration. Kind regards.
